title: Reference approach: Data Augmentation
answer: Implement data augmentation in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: transforms.Compose, RandomHorizontalFlip, ToTensor. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 086. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
from torchvision import transforms
train=transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize((224,224)),transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),transforms.ToTensor()]); valid=transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize((224,224)),transforms.ToTensor()])
print(type(train).__name__, type(valid).__name__) # Requires compatible torchvision.
reference_code:
from torchvision import transforms
train=transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize((224,224)),transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),transforms.ToTensor()]); valid=transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize((224,224)),transforms.ToTensor()])
print(type(train).__name__, type(valid).__name__) # Requires compatible torchvision.
review_notes: Do not treat source-string grading as proof that numerical behavior is correct.
Run in a supported local environment or isolated runner.
Keep input data synthetic unless a dataset has an appropriate license and documented provenance.
